preconditions.description: The root of the tree must be a valid TreeNode object.
The home value must be a positive integer within the range of 1 to 100,000.
The distance K must be a positive integer within the range of 1 to 20.

postconditions.description: The output must be the string representation of the maximum number of ladoos Chhota Bheem can eat.
The maximum number of ladoos must include the ladoos at Chhota Bheem's home.

postconditions.expression: return_value <= sum(node.val for node in nodes_within_distance)
postconditions.description: The maximum number of ladoos must not exceed the sum of ladoos in nodes within distance K from Chhota Bheem's home.
